settings.hero_desc: A gold tiger figurine mounted on a plinth with an engraved nameplate. A bold, symbolic award for top performers, sales champions and 'gold standard' recognition.
settings.s1_body: A tiger symbolises power, focus and excellence - the perfect emblem for your top performers. This gold figurine stands on a plinth with an engraved plaque naming the award and recipient. A striking 'gold standard' trophy for sales champions, leadership recognition and annual awards - available as a single piece or a coordinated set.
settings.case_body: Created as a 'gold standard' recognition trophy, this tiger figurine gave top performers a bold, symbolic award - a piece they proudly displayed as a mark of their achievement.
settings.case_quote: Our top performers love it. The gold tiger really says 'best of the best'.
